question: 销售额最高的五个客户是谁？
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM northwind.customers c JOIN northwind.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN northwind.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer LIMIT 5

question: 2025 年每个月的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM northwind.orders o JOIN northwind.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: 各商品类别的销售额排名如何？
gold_sql: SELECT c.category_name AS category, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM northwind.categories c JOIN northwind.products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN northwind.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, category

question: 销量最高的五种商品是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS product, SUM(od.quantity) AS units_sold FROM northwind.products p JOIN northwind.order_details od ON od.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, product LIMIT 5

question: 每个收货国家有多少订单？
gold_sql: SELECT ship_country AS country, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM northwind.orders GROUP BY ship_country ORDER BY order_count DESC, country

question: 每位销售人员负责的净销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM northwind.employees e JOIN northwind.orders o ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN northwind.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, employee

question: 平均每笔订单的金额是多少？
gold_sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total FROM northwind.orders o JOIN northwind.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS average_order_value FROM order_totals

question: 哪些订单还没有发货？
gold_sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, required_date FROM northwind.orders WHERE shipped_date IS NULL ORDER BY required_date, order_id LIMIT 100

question: 2025 年一共给了多少折扣？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * od.discount), 2) AS discount_amount FROM northwind.orders o JOIN northwind.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

question: 已经停产的商品有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, unit_price, units_in_stock FROM northwind.products WHERE discontinued IS TRUE ORDER BY product_id LIMIT 100

question: 当前库存金额最高的五种商品是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT product_name AS product, ROUND(unit_price * units_in_stock, 2) AS inventory_value FROM northwind.products ORDER BY inventory_value DESC, product LIMIT 5

question: 每个供应商提供多少种商品？
gold_sql: SELECT s.company_name AS supplier, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM northwind.suppliers s LEFT JOIN northwind.products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.company_name ORDER BY product_count DESC, supplier

question: 比较 2024 和 2025 年各月的销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::integer AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date)::integer AS month, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM northwind.orders o JOIN northwind.order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month

question: 各承运商完成了多少已发货订单？
gold_sql: SELECT s.company_name AS shipper, COUNT(*) AS shipped_order_count FROM northwind.shippers s JOIN northwind.orders o ON o.shipper_id = s.shipper_id WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.shipper_id, s.company_name ORDER BY shipped_order_count DESC, shipper

question: 哪些客户在样例期间重复下过订单？
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name AS customer, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM northwind.customers c JOIN northwind.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer LIMIT 100
